note: PLACEHOLDER written by Claude Code so the Spectrum Player can be built. Priyanshi decides what every sound means and replaces these values; the code reads them from here and has none of its own. Every 'meaning' is shown on screen as the text equivalent of the sound.

pitch.meaning: Pitch follows colour: low notes are the shorter colours, high notes are the longer colours.

loudness.meaning: Loudness follows brightness: brighter colours are louder, so a dip in the graph goes quiet.

bump.meaning: A chime marks a bump the team has marked on the graph.

dip.meaning: A falling note marks a dip the team has marked on the graph.
